g.text: Messages cannot select tenant, owner, roles,
provider URL, policy version, or shared readers.
Principal is trusted because the host creates it.
This is not a public authentication server.
Web cookies identify browser sessions, not verified people.
No automatic cloud fallback, tools, shell,
Selected prompt data still reaches the model service.
Green: implemented controls. Blue: host trust assumption.
Orange: external controls, not deployed or verified here.
LLM judgments are fallible observations, not authorization.
